_comment: Contract fixture for the TOKENLESS signup event (go-live readiness plan 2026-08-25 item 3). POST /api/signup appends this row shape when a signup PROVIDES AN EMAIL but presents NO valid CTA token: send_key EMPTY STRING, user_id = the created account id, and the account's (lower-cased, unverified) email under the PINNED schema key `email` - the exact key the pipeline fold reads first (pipeline cli._signup_event_email; account_email / signup_email remain legacy aliases). No email -> no event; a VALID token keeps today's tokened row (which also carries `email` when present) and appends NO tokenless duplicate. event_key follows the UNCHANGED byte-exact formula: slots [send_key, message_id, event, touch-slot] joined by the 0x1f byte, UTF-8, SHA-256 lowercase hex; for `signup` the user_id occupies the touch slot and message_id is the empty string, so two tokenless signups by different accounts hash DISTINCT keys while a replay of one collapses.
